errors.text: The proposed SRO-controlled mechanism and approximately 1.2 nm barrier length are not established for equiatomic FCC FeNiCrMn.
The sole citation concerns MoNbTaW refractory HEA and explicitly identifies the SRO–edge-dislocation relationship as an unresolved question; it does not support the claimed mechanism.
The strain-rate regime of 10^-4–10^-1 s^-1 does not reconstruct or test the target boundary of 10^8–10^10 s^-1 in molecular dynamics.
The hypothesis omits the target mechanism of vacancy-initiated Shockley partial nucleation, intrinsic/extrinsic stacking-fault formation, and local HCP-like coordination without bulk transformation.
